snippet.title: Humanica - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the early access release date trailer for Humanica, a city-builder game developed by PanfachDev. Experience the journey from sticks and stones to iron tools and windmills in this game about an ancient settlement. Arm your settlers and build walls with towers to defend your settlement from evil wild animals and hordes of nomads. Humanica is launching on March 3 for PC (Steam) in Early Access.
